# LeagueSphere

> LeagueSphere is a web platform for organizing flag-football league play: gameday schedules, live scores, league standings, team rosters, and officials assignments. Page content is primarily in German; this file and the JSON API use English labels.

## About LeagueSphere

LeagueSphere ("Leaguesphere") serves amateur flag-football leagues in Germany. The typical league runs several gamedays per season at a central venue. On a gameday, multiple games are scheduled on one or more fields with assigned officials (referees). Referees track each game in the liveticker: scores per half, touchdowns, extra points, timeouts.

Core entities and their relationships:

- **Season**: a yearly competition period; leagues and gamedays belong to a season.
- **League**: a competition within a season, identified by a slug; standings are computed per league and season.
- **Gameday**: a scheduled event day with games; statuses are DRAFT, PUBLISHED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED. Only non-draft gamedays are public.
- **Game**: part of a gameday; has a scheduled time, a field, a status (Geplant = scheduled, Gestartet = started, beendet = finished), and results per half (first half, second half).
- **Team**: has a name, description, location, and optional logo; rosters are public per team.
- **Officials**: referee assignments for games on a gameday.

## Public pages (German UI)

- [Gameday overview](https://leaguesphere.app/gamedays/): all league gamedays with dates and status. Landing page of the site.
- [Liveticker](https://leaguesphere.app/liveticker/): live-updating scores for today's games, including the latest game events (touchdowns, extra points, timeouts). Best source for current in-play data.
- [League table](https://leaguesphere.app/leaguetable/): standings per league and season, including points, wins/losses, score difference, and tie-break resolution.
- [Gameday detail](https://leaguesphere.app/gamedays/gameday/{id}/): schedule of all games on a gameday with results and progress; finalized after the last game ends.
- [Team roster](https://leaguesphere.app/passcheck/team/{id}/list/): public roster of a single team (players per season).
- [Officials assignments](https://leaguesphere.app/officials/einsaetze/): which officiating team referees which games, per gameday.

## Machine-readable data (JSON, no authentication)

LeagueSphere has one public API, `/api/snapshot/`: anonymous, read-only JSON, readable cross-origin from any website, with an ETag for conditional requests. Other `/api/` paths are internal to LeagueSphere's own pages and may change without notice.

- [API: Snapshot](https://leaguesphere.app/api/snapshot/): gamedays for a scope (`team`, `league`, `season`, `year`, `date_from`/`date_to`, `status`), with opt-in `include=games` (games and scores), `logs` (event logs), `teams` (full team names and logos), `standings` (league tables of the league-seasons in scope) and `live` (today's live scores and ticker events). Schema version 1 changes additively only.
- [Dynamic data guide](https://leaguesphere.app/llms-dynamic.txt): freshness, cache headers, and game-status vocabulary for all dynamic endpoints.

## Dynamic content policy

Live data (liveticker, running games) changes in near real time during gamedays. Prefer the snapshot API for current data and respect its ETag. A gameday's results are final once its games are "beendet" (finished); finalized gameday pages and snapshot data are stable and safe to cite.

- Crawler policy: /robots.txt (AI retrieval crawlers allowed; training-only crawlers blocked)
